capabilities: Publish notes to the WeChat Official Account draft box
Render Markdown with eleven themes using fully inlined CSS
Upload, convert, and compress local and external images
Preview articles in a phone frame with link and sensitive-word checks
Export the rendered article as a PNG long image
disambiguation: Not a general blog or website publisher; it targets WeChat Official Account drafts specifically, with no other publishing destination.
extras: Desktop-only (no mobile Obsidian). AppSecret is stored in plaintext in local settings, with a manual token mode offered as an alternative. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian notes have no path to WeChat Official Account publishing: pasting loses styling, and images and math need manual re-uploading and reformatting.

relations.evidence: highlight.js — 代码高亮引擎与官方主题样式
KaTeX — 数学公式排版与内联样式

requires.name: WeChat Official Account (AppID/AppSecret or access token)

summary: Publishing tool that converts Markdown notes into styled WeChat Official Account articles and saves them straight to the account's draft box.
